title: BusinessProcess
description: TOGAF-sourced representation archetype — an end-to-end representation of business activities spanning multiple GSM Structures. A Business Process is NOT a Structure in GSM: if it were, its activity steps (Mechanisms) would need to belong to both the Process and the executing Components, violating GSM's single Structure→Mechanism constitutive relationship. Instead, a Process is a cross-structural representation — it defines the sequencing of Mechanisms belonging to different Structures. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Business Process (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

processScope.description: Process scope classification. STRATEGIC = long-term planning/governance processes. TACTICAL = medium-term coordination processes. OPERATIONAL = day-to-day execution processes. TOGAF mapping: Business Process scope classification.

automationLevel.description: Degree of automation. TOGAF mapping: Process automation assessment.
